settings.Long molecules: cutoff energy and gradient differences compared at their published precision
settings.Hessian geometries: method-specific optimized XYZ when present, otherwise original XYZ
settings.GFN2 analytic frequencies: matrix comparison uses modes with reference |ν| > 50 cm⁻¹
settings.Units: energy and orbital energies Eh, gradient Eh/bohr, charges e, dipole e·bohr, frequency cm⁻¹
